notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]Ace of Space has been updated with new functionality:[/p][list][*][p]Steam cloud saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Audial and visual feedback for interface buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Player's spaceship now moves at a steady speed when not being controlled. Destruction by going out of bounds now should not be possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Serious optimization improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress reset button now reuires three presses in quick succession to be activated to prevent accidental triggering.[/p][/*][/list][p]Have fun![/p]
